metrics.name: destination_click_to_application_conversion
metrics.pm_question: What is the click -> application_started conversion rate, sliced by destination and visa_type?
metrics.formula: count(application_started keyed to a prior destination_card_clicked) / count(destination_card_clicked), grouped by destination, visa_type
metrics.note: Cross-event conversion — not materialized here; computed at query time joining spec 10. Denominator clicks are available pre-aggregated in destination_click_daily_agg.

metrics.name: page_version_ctr_to_application
metrics.pm_question: Does page_version v4 outperform v3 on click-through to application_started?
metrics.formula: conversion (application_started / destination_card_clicked) compared across page_version in {v3, v4}
metrics.note: Cross-event. Click denominator by page_version is pre-aggregated in destination_click_daily_agg.

metrics.name: guest_browse_click_share
metrics.pm_question: What share of destination card clicks come from is_guest_browse = 1 sessions?
metrics.formula: sum(guest_clicks) / count(clicks), where guest_clicks = clicks with is_guest_browse = 1

metrics.name: guest_browse_conversion
metrics.pm_question: Do guest-browse clicks convert to application_started at a different rate than logged-in clicks?
metrics.note: Cross-event. Guest click denominator is pre-aggregated in destination_click_daily_agg.

metrics.name: flow_conversion
metrics.pm_question: How does conversion differ between explore and search flows?
metrics.note: Cross-event. Click denominator by flow is pre-aggregated in destination_click_daily_agg.

metrics.name: co_travelers_effect
metrics.pm_question: Does co_travelers > 0 change which destinations are clicked / their conversion?
metrics.formula: click volume and conversion by destination, split on co_travelers > 0 vs = 0
metrics.note: Click-volume-by-destination half is single-table; conversion half is cross-event with spec 10. co_travelers is not a dimension of destination_click_daily_agg, so this is computed at query time from the base table.
